keySentence: Jack went to the market to sell the cow.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The family was poor. The cow gave no milk. Mother said, "Sell it." Jack went to the market to sell the cow.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack and his mother had no money. Their old cow gave no more milk. Mother said, "Take the cow. Sell her." Jack said, "Yes, Mother." Jack went to the market to sell the cow.
facts.Word cards: sell = 팔다 / milk = 우유 / money = 돈 / cow = 소
